correctness.rationale: The PBH equivalence is applied to the exact symmetric Laplacian. Reflection decomposes the spectrum; even modes vanish at the observed node iff 6 divides n. Odd Jacobi eigenvalues are simple and strictly increasing in w, and interlacing shows even/odd coincidences only at w=1. Setting the measured coordinate to zero forces eigenvalue 1+2w and the remaining Dirichlet or antiperiodic tail yields exactly the indexed cosine resonance set. Both directions and n=5, positive w boundaries are handled; 816 reproducibility tests passed but are not used as proof.

value.rationale: The theorem classifies a natural minimal edge-weight fault of a cyclic consensus network for one fixed physically motivated observation vertex, rather than one arbitrary numeric instance. It identifies entire cycle-size families that stay unobservable at every positive weight and exact isolated positive nonuniform sensor-failure weights, an operationally meaningful design constraint beyond generic observability and the known uniform cycle result.
